alerts.reason: Landec’s consolidated revenue decline narrowed from 5.05% in August to 1.08% in November. Lifecore’s revenue growth (B) supports a forecast that the intervening quarter stays above −5.00%. Curation Foods’ planned reduction in its legacy vegetable and tray business (A) could outweigh that growth by the quarter starting February 28, pushing reported consolidated revenue to a decline of at least 5.00% year over year.
